# Worked Example

A filled-in plan for a fictional project, showing the card as it should read in chat and in the file: the title is the first line, no front matter, short cells, six steps, within about 80 lines. Content is illustrative; do not copy it into real plans.

## Steps and skills
`Architect → Author → Validate → back to 1`

| Phase | # | Step | Skill / what happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Architect | 1 | Plan | `design-spec-plan`: this plan |
| Architect | 2 | Design | No skill. Visual design in Figma |
| Author | 3 | Write | `design-spec-authoring`: write the specs |
| Author | 4 | Build | Prototype, test or hand off. Suggested: `design-spec-preview` |
| Validate | 5 | Review | `design-spec-audit`: QA against the spec, end-of-day or before handoff |
| Validate | 6 | Update | `design-spec-authoring`: keep the spec current |

Start where your project is; re-run this plan only for a big change. **Working together:** share the project; one owner for `spec-plan.md`.
